$comment: Topic maps for scripts/gap-audit.py. Each topic groups themes; each theme
groups concepts. A concept declares `terms` (lexical probes run against the
index), an optional `probe` sentence (used by --semantic), and `canonical`
works that would close the gap if the verdict comes back absent/mention-only.
Keep terms specific: generic words ('time', 'change', 'identity') match

temporality-ontology.title: Temporality & ontology — 3D/endurantism vs 4D/perdurantism
temporality-ontology.question: Does the collection cover how identity persists through time — the 3D/4D split — across analytic metaphysics, process philosophy, foundational ontologies, industrial 4D engineering, and temporal data modelling? And does it cover the mismatch between the philosophical and the data-engineering traditions?

themes.note: The philosophical literature that actually argues the 3D/4D question. This is where the terms endurantism/perdurantism come from.
